joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until((#G1_Humidity).airQualitySensor_humidity < 50)
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#G1_Humidity).airQualitySensor_humidity >= 50)
all(#Dehumidifier).dehumidifier_setDehumidifierMode("drying")
triggered = true

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 습도가 50% 이상이 될 때마다, 그룹1 태그가 붙은 제습기를 모두 건조모드로 작동시켜.
command_eng: Whenever the humidity reaches 50% or higher, set all dehumidifiers with the Group 1 tag to drying mode.
